name: broagentai
description: Browser extension that sends plain-text JSON commands to user-selected MCP servers through a local bridge

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:host
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:extension:firefox && npm run build:host
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @broagentai/extension && npm run e2e:plugin-isolation -w @broagentai/extension && npm run e2e:native -w @broagentai/extension
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
